contract: Reviewed user-supplied captions and guarded public YouTube acquisition converge on one durable job, canonical source and timestamped transcript. Optional bounded audio/video artifacts use the same per-hop session egress guard, fixed host validation, progress and cancellation state.
acceptance: Accept one canonical HTTPS YouTube video identity; reject credentials, alternate ports, playlists, malformed IDs, private destinations and redirects outside fixed public video endpoints.
Preview VTT, SRT or timed JSON captions without mutation; persist only the unchanged reviewed content with language, user-supplied/manual/automatic provenance and exact timestamp source links.
Retrieve actual public metadata and selected caption/audio/video artifacts through the pinned-IP egress client and optional pinned yt-dlp adapter; no downloader subprocess or unguarded network path.
Durable jobs expose ordered stage events, restart interruption, progress, cancellation, errors and independently landed transcript/artifact state; late failure does not erase completed output.
Canonical video source, original caption source and transcript deduplicate by video ID; immutable request replay returns the original result and changed reuse conflicts.
Captured allocation home, restricted sessions, byte/duration/redirect caps, artifact hashes, native approval policy, actual HTTP and DOM consumers are enforced.
remaining_limits: Live success depends on the optional pinned yt-dlp package and public YouTube availability; unavailable or blocked access is recorded as a failed durable job, never provider success.
Acquisition is capped at six hours, 1 MiB per caption response, 32 MiB per selected single-file media artifact and 64 MiB aggregate guarded response bytes.
The adapter selects a bounded direct HTTPS stream; multi-stream muxing, DRM, private/authenticated videos, playlists and arbitrary video sites are outside this task.
Central dashboard registration and shared capability navigation are integrated by the root lane.
repair_history: First gate compile and 120 runtime tests passed; UI had an ambiguous scoped-text assertion and selected-job state could remain stale after the list observed terminal progress.
Repair1 scoped the assertion to caption review and synchronized selected job state from durable list refresh; compile, 120 runtime tests and 4 real HTTP DOM tests passed.
